title: List of features and items that affect saving throws
html:
This is meant to be a comprehensive list of all sources of effects that directly affect saving throws. Please add any you find to be missing.

General information

  • A source can cause different effects as part of its mechanic, but this article lists only the saving throw related portion.
  • Items listed in this article do not include mundane gear pieces of common quality and basic enchanted versions thereof.
  • If a condition is incurred by a singular source (for ex. a class feature), this article lists that singular source. Otherwise only the condition is documented.
  • For conditions caused by gear-exclusive passives and actions, the gear item takes pecedence over the passive or action in the list.
  • Proficiency, Advantage, and Disadvantage do not add to the saving throw rolls directly, but modify them in a special way. See the corresponding mechanics pages for full information.

Bonus to saving throws

Class features

  • Shield Master (Feat) - Dexterity saves +2 when wielding a shield. If a spell forces you to make a Dexterity saving throw, you can use your  Reaction to diminish the effect's damage. On a failed save, you only take half damage. On a successful save, you don't take any damage, even if you normally would
  •  Aura of Protection - All allies in a 3 m / 10 ft radius around the Paladin with this aura gain a bonus to saves equal to the paladin's Charisma modifier
  •  Bardic Inspiration - Target of  Bardic Defence gains a 1d6 bonus to the next save
  •  Combat Inspiration -  Valiant Defence grants the caster a 1d6 bonus to the next save
  •  Magic Awareness - All allies in a 3 m / 10 ft radius around the Wild Magic Barbarian gain a bonus equal to their proficiency bonus to saves against spells, for 1 turn

Spells

  •  Bless - Saves +1d4
  •  Resistance - Saves +1d4
  •  Warding Bond - Saves +1

Items

All saves

  • Absolute's Warboard - Saves +1 if the wielder has the Brand of the Absolute
  • Armour of Agility - Saves +2
  • Bonespike Boots - Saves +1 when not wearing armour or holding a shield
  • Cerebral Citadel Gloves -  Charm or  Frighten a target to gain a 1d4 bonus to saves for 3 turns. Strength saves +1
  • Cloak of Protection - Saves +1
  • Corellon's Grace - Saves +2 when not wearing armour
  • Dark Justiciar Helm - Saves against melee attacks +1 while being obscured. Constitution saves +1
  • Dark Justiciar Helmet - Saves against spells +1. Constitution saves +1
  • Defender Greataxe - Once per round on wielder's first attack, use  Defensive Attack to reduce this weapon's enchantment by 1 and increase saves by 1
  • Emblazoned Plate of the Marshal - Saves +2
  • Flame Enamelled Armour - Saves +2
  • Flawed Helldusk Helmet - Saves against spells +2. Constitution saves +1
  • Gloves of Soul Catching - Soul Catching: Gain a +5 bonus to the next saving throw after an unarmed hit, if Soul Catching Prowess was chosen ( Recharge: Per turn)
  • Helldusk Helmet - Saves against spells +2
  • Helm of Balduran - Saves +1
  • Jhannyl's Gloves - Saves +1
  • Moon Devotion Robe - Saves +1
  • Phalar Aluve - Phalar Aluve: Sing grants all allies within 6 m / 20 ft radius a 1d4 bonus to Charisma, Wisdom, and Intelligence saves for 5 turns ( Recharge: Short rest)
  • Ring of Protection - Saves +1
  • Robe of Supreme Defences - While concentrating, add wearer's spellcasting modifier to saves
  • Safeguard Shield - Saves +1
  • Sword of the Emperor - Saves against spells +2
  • The Protecty Sparkswall - Saves +1 while being imbued with  Lightning Charges
  • Viconia's Priestess Robe - Saves +2 while under the effect of Shield of Faith

Strength saves

  • Blackguard's Gauntlets - Strength saves +1
  • Dark Justiciar Gauntlets (Uncommon) - Strength saves +1
  • Dark Justiciar Gauntlets (Rare) - Strength saves +1
  • Dwarven Splintmail - Strength saves +1
  • Gauntlets of Hill Giant Strength - Strength saves +1
  • Gloves of Battlemage's Power - Strength saves +1
  • Gloves of Heroism - Strength saves +1
  • Gloves of the Automaton - Strength saves +1
  • Gloves of the Growling Underdog - Strength saves +1
  • Helldusk Gloves - Strength saves +1
  • Hellrider's Pride - Strength saves +1
  • Legacy of the Masters - Strength saves +1
  • Luminous Gloves - Strength saves +1
  • The Reviving Hands - Strength saves +1
  • Unwanted Masterwork Gauntlets - Strength saves +1

Dexterity saves

  • Boots of Persistence - Dexterity saves +1
  • Boots of Psionic Movement - Dexterity saves +1
  • Covert Cowl - Dexterity saves +1
  • Dark Justiciar Boots - Dexterity saves +1
  • Helmet of Arcane Acuity - Dexterity saves +1
  • Helmet of Grit - Dexterity saves +1
  • Slinging Shoes - Dexterity saves +1
  • The Graceful Cloth - Dexterity saves +1

Other saves

  • Cerebral Citadel Armour - Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saves +1 if infested by a mind flayer tadpole
  • Circlet of Psionic Revenge - Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saves +1 if githyanki (or disguised as one)
  • Helmet of Smiting - Constitution saves +1
  • Holy Lance Helm - Constitution saves +1
  • Seemingly Gleaming Ring - Charisma saves +1
  • Tyrannical Jackboots - Charisma saves +1

Passives

Forbidden Knowledge
From partially deciphering the  Necromancy of Thay, you gain a +1 bonus to Wisdom Saving Throws and Ability Checks.

Conditions

  •  Anointed in Splendour - Saves +2 (received at Stormshore Tabernacle)
  •  Bless - Target gains a 1d4 bonus to saves (also see Water Queen's House for once-per-character-per-game until-long-rest Bless by Umberlee)
  •  Bliss Spores - Gain a 1d6 bonus to saves until the next long rest (bestowed upon the player character after completing Defeat the Duergar Intruders)
  •  Fetcher's Favour - Gain a 1d4 bonus to Charisma saves (bestowed upon the party at High Hall after completing Find Mol and gaining her as an ally)
  •  Happy - Saves +1
  •  Loviatar's Love - Wisdom saves +2 for 3 turns when at 30% hit points and lower
  •  Rapture - Gain a 1d6 bonus to saves until the next long rest (see Naoise Nallinto page for further details)
  •  Resistance - Gain a 1d4 bonus to saves
  •  Sweet Stone Features - 1d4 bonus to saves, does not stack with Bless but is essentially permanent
  •  Volo's Guide to Monsters - Saves +2 (bestowed upon the party at High Hall after completing Rescue Volo)

Penalty to saving throws

Class features

  •  Boar Companion - All creatures within the  Kick Up Muck area suffer a -2 penalty to Dexterity saves
  •  Wolf Companion - Target of  Infectious Bite suffers a -1 penalty to Constitution saves. Target also suffers disadvantage on Constitution saves

Spells

  •  Find Familiar: Rat - Target of  Infectious Bite suffers a -1 penalty to Constitution saves. Target also suffers disadvantage on Constitution saves

Illithid powers

  •  Fracture Psyche - Target suffers a -1 penalty to saves. The full-illithid version applies a -5 penalty instead.
  •  Shatter Psyche - Target suffers a -2 penalty to saves. The full-illithid version applies a -5 penalty instead.

Items

  • Gloves of Baneful Striking - On a weapon hit, the target suffers a 1d4 penalty to saves against wearer's next spell, for 2 turns
  • Phalar Aluve - Phalar Aluve: Shriek incurs a 1d4 penalty to Charisma, Wisdom, and Intelligence saves of all enemies within 6 m / 20 ft radius, for 5 turns ( Recharge: Short rest)
  • Seemingly Gleaming Ring - Wisdom saves -1

Conditions

  •  Bane - Target suffers a 1d4 penalty to saves
  •  Bloodless - Saves -1
  •  Mental Fatigue - Target suffers a -1 penalty to Wisdom, Intelligence, and Charisma saves per remaining turn of the condition
  •  Reverberation - Target suffers a -1 penalty to Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saves per remaining turn of the condition
  •  Slowed - Target suffers a -2 penalty to Dexterity saves

Proficiency in saving throws

Class features

  •  Iron Mind - Proficiency in Wisdom and Intelligence saves
  •  Resilient - Increase an ability by 1 (max 20). Gain proficiency in that ability's saves
  •  Transmuter's Stone: Constitution - Proficiency in Constitution saves

Items

  • Elixir of Dwarven Resilience - Proficiency in saves until making three successful saves or until a long rest, upon consumption
  • Helmet of Autonomy - Proficiency in Wisdom saves

Advantage on saving throws

Races

  •  Elf - Advantage on saves against being  Charmed
  •  Drow - Advantage on saves against being  Charmed
  •  Dwarf - Advantage on saves against being  Poisoned
    •  Duergar - Advantage on saves against illusions and against being  Charmed and  Paralysed
  •  Gnome - Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saves
  •  Half-Elf - Advantage on saves against being  Charmed
  •  Halfling - Advantage on saves against being  Frightened
    •  Strongheart Halfling - Advantage on saves against being  Poisoned

Class features

  •  Countercharm - All allies in a 9 m / 30 ft radius around the Bard gain advantage on saves against being  Charmed or  Frightened, for 3 turns
  •  Danger Sense - Advantage on Dexterity saves against traps, spells and surfaces as long as Barbarian is not Blinded or Incapacitated
  •  Frenzy - Advantage on Strength saves
  •  Lucky - Gain 3 Luck Points that recharge after a long rest, which you can use to gain advantage on the next saving throw, one point per throw
  •  Patient Defence - Advantage on Dexterity saves
  •  Rage - Advantage on Strength saves
  •  Rage: Bear Heart - Advantage on Strength saves
  •  Rage: Eagle Heart - Advantage on Strength saves
  •  Rage: Elk Heart - Advantage on Strength saves
  •  Rage: Tiger Heart - Advantage on Strength saves
  •  Rage: Wolf Heart - Advantage on Strength saves

Spells

  •  Heroes' Feast - Advantage on Wisdom saves
  • Mage Slayer (Feat) - Advantage on any save against a spell that was cast within the melee range at you. Enemies you hit have disadvantage on concentration saves
  •  Protection from Poison - Advantage on saves against being  Poisoned

Items

All saves

  • Chancer's Carcanet - Expend a  Reaction to make a save with advantage ( Recharge: Long rest)
  • Shar's Spear of Evening - Advantage on saves while being obscured
  • Shadeclinger Armour - Advantage on saves while being obscured

Constitution saves

  • Amulet of Greater Health - Advantage on Constitution saves
  • Armour of Landfall - Advantage on Constitution saves
  • Barkskin Armour - Advantage on Constitution saves
  • Dark Justiciar Half-Plate (Rare) - Advantage on Constitution saves
  • Dark Justiciar Half-Plate (Very Rare) - Advantage on Constitution saves
  • Drunken Cloth - Advantage on Constitution saves while being  Drunk
  • Moon Devotion Robe - Advantage on Constitution saves
  • Spidersilk Armour - Advantage on Constitution saves
  • Steelwatcher Helmet - Advantage on Constitution saves

Dexterity saves

  • Acrobat Shoes - Advantage on Dexterity saves
  • Elven Chain - Advantage on Dexterity saves
  • Gontr Mael - Celestial Haste: Advantage on Dexterity saves for 5 turns ( Recharge: Long rest)
  • Ketheric's Shield - Advantage on Dexterity saves

Other saves

  • Aberration Hunters' Amulet - Advantage on Intelligence saves if githyanki (or disguised as one)
  • Amulet of the Harpers - Advantage on Wisdom saves
  • Balduran's Giantslayer - Giant Form: Advantage on Strength saves for 10 turns ( Recharge: Short rest)
  • Blackguard's Plate - Advantage on Wisdom saves
  • Elixir of the Colossus - Advantage on Strength saves, upon consumption
  • Elixir of Peerless Focus - Advantage on Concentration saves and on saves against being  Charmed, upon consumption
  • Fey Semblance Amulet - Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saves
  • Ring of Mind-Shielding - Advantage on saves against being  Charmed
  • Selûne's Spear of Night - Advantage on Wisdom saves
  • Silver Sword of the Astral Plane - Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saves if githyanki (or disguised as one)
  • The Mighty Cloth - Advantage on saves against being  Restrained

Spell saves

  • Armour of Moonbasking - Advantage on saves against spells, even while being in Wild Shape
  • Orphic Hammer - Advantage on saves against spells
  • Shelter of Athkatla - Advantage on saves against spells
  • Veil of the Morning - Advantage on saves against Undead attacks and spells
  • Viconia's Walking Fortress - Advantage on saves against spells

Conditions

  •  Enlarged - Target has advantage on Strength saves
  •  Gaseous Form - Advantage on Constitution, Dexterity, and Strength saves
  •  Githzerai Mind Barrier - Advantage on Intelligence saves (received in the Mind Flayer Colony)
  •  Haste Spores - Target has advantage on Dexterity saves
  •  Hastened - Target has advantage on Dexterity saves

Disadvantage on saving throws

Class features

  •  Eldritch Strike - Target suffers disadvantage on the next save against the caster's spell
  •  Nature's Wrath - Target suffers disadvantage on Dexterity saves

Spells

  •  Bestow Curse: Charisma Disadvantage - Target suffers disadvantage on Charisma saves
  •  Bestow Curse: Constitution Disadvantage - Target suffers disadvantage on Constitution saves
  •  Bestow Curse: Dexterity Disadvantage - Target suffers disadvantage on Dexterity saves
  •  Bestow Curse: Strength Disadvantage - Target suffers disadvantage on Strength saves
  •  Bestow Curse: Intelligence Disadvantage - Target suffers disadvantage on Intelligence saves
  •  Bestow Curse: Wisdom Disadvantage - Target suffers disadvantage on Wisdom saves
  •  Contagion: Filth Fever - Target suffers disadvantage on Strength saves
  •  Contagion: Seizure - Target suffers disadvantage on Dexterity saves
  •  Contagion: Slimy Doom - Target suffers disadvantage on Constitution saves
  •  Evard's Black Tentacles - Target suffers disadvantage on Dexterity saves
  •  Find Familiar: Frog - Target of  Bufotoxin suffers disadvantage on Dexterity saves
  •  Flesh to Stone (the 3 stages before  Petrification) - Target suffers disadvantage on Dexterity saves
  •  Otto's Irresistible Dance - Target suffers disadvantage on Dexterity saves

Weapon actions

  •  Heartstopper - Target suffers disadvantage on Constitution saves
  •  Weakening Strike - Target suffers disadvantage on Strength saves

Items

  • Drakethroat Glaive - Targets have disadvantage on saves against wielder's dragonborn breath weapon
  • Faltering Will - Disadvantage on Wisdom saves until long rest, upon consumption
  • Gauntlets of the Warmaster - Targets have disadvantage on saves against wearer's manoeuvres and weapon actions
  • Hollow's Staff - Targets have disadvantage on saves against wielder's necromancy spells
  • Jagged Spear - On a hit with this spear, targets suffer disadvantage on Constitution saves for 2 turns if they fail the DC 10 Charisma save
  • Oil of Diminution - Target suffers disadvantage on Strength saves for 2 turns if they fail the DC 11 Constitution save
  • Reaper's Embrace - Disadvantage on Dexterity saves for the wearer while Reaper's Rigidity is toggled on
  • Resonance Stone - All creatures in a 9 m / 30 ft radius suffer disadvantage on Wisdom, Intelligence, and Charisma saves
  • Rhapsody - While at +3 bonus from Scarlet Remittance, consume it to inflict disadvantage on saves upon hostile creatures against wielder's spells ( Recharge: Long rest)
  • Risky Ring - Disadvantage on saves for the wearer
  • Sharpened Snare Cuirass - Targets have disadvantage on saves to resist wearer's  Restraining attacks and spells
  • Shield of the Undevout - Enemies have disadvantage on saves to resist wielder's spells or actions that inflict  Fear
  • Staff of Cherished Necromancy - Targets have disadvantage on saves against wielder's necromancy spells
  • Tadpole Elixir - Disadvantage on Constitution, Wisdom and Intelligence saves, upon consumption

Conditions

  •  Arcane Hunger - Gale suffers disadvantage on Constitution saves
    •  Greater Arcane Hunger - Gale suffers disadvantage on saves
    •  Severe Arcane Hunger - Gale suffers disadvantage on saves
  •  Bleeding - Target suffers disadvantage on Constitution saves
  •  Burden of Time Aura - Beasts and non-Elf Humanoids in a 3 m / 10 ft radius around He Who Was suffer disadvantage on saves
  •  Command: Grovel - Target suffers disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity saves
  •  Constricted - Target suffers disadvantage on Dexterity saves
  •  Dazed - Target suffers disadvantage on Wisdom saves
  •  Encrusted with Frost - Target suffers disadvantage on Dexterity saves
  •  Ensnared - Target suffers disadvantage on Dexterity saves
    •  Ensnared - Target suffers disadvantage on Dexterity saves
    •  Ensnared - Target suffers disadvantage on Dexterity saves
  •  Entangled - Target suffers disadvantage on Dexterity saves
  •  Enwebbed - Target suffers disadvantage on Dexterity saves
  •  Feverish - Suffer disadvantage on Strength saves
    •  Filth Fever - Suffer disadvantage on Strength saves
  •  Harrowed - Target suffers disadvantage on Wisdom and Charisma saves (the aura emanates from the Echo of a Lost Love)
  •  Heavily Encumbered - Suffer disadvantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saves
  •  Hideous Laughter - Target suffers disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity saves
  •  Infected - Target suffers disadvantage on Constitution saves
  •  Maimed - Target suffers disadvantage on Dexterity saves
  •  Muddy - Target suffers disadvantage on Dexterity saves
  •  Prone - Target suffers disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity saves
  •  Reduced - Target suffers disadvantage on Strength saves
  •  Restrained - Target suffers disadvantage on Dexterity saves
  •  Rotting - Target suffers disadvantage on Charisma saves
    •  Flesh Rot - Target suffers disadvantage on Charisma saves
  •  Sea Plague - All creatures in the area suffer disadvantage on Strength saves
  •  Septic - Target suffers disadvantage on Constitution saves
  •  Shadow-Cursed Vines - Target suffers disadvantage on Dexterity saves
  •  Shocked - Target suffers disadvantage on Dexterity saves
  •  Stricken With Blinding Sickness - Target suffers disadvantage on Wisdom saves

Automatical failure on saving throws

Spells

  •  Hold Monster - Target automatically fails all Strength and Dexterity saves
  •  Hold Person - Target automatically fails all Strength and Dexterity saves

Items

  •  Crawler Mucus - Target automatically fails all Strength and Dexterity saves
  •  Drow Poison - Target automatically fails all Strength and Dexterity saves

Conditions

  •  Befuddled - Target automatically fails all Strength and Dexterity saves
  •  Confused Stupor - Target automatically fails all Strength and Dexterity saves
  •  Downed - Target automatically fails all Strength and Dexterity saves
  •  Knocked Out - Target automatically fails all Strength and Dexterity saves
  •  Lethargic - Target automatically fails all Strength and Dexterity saves
  •  Paralysed - Target automatically fails all Strength and Dexterity saves
  •  Sleeping - Target automatically fails all Strength and Dexterity saves
  •  Stunned - Target automatically fails all Strength and Dexterity saves

Other

Class features

  •  Dungeon Delver: Perception - Advantage on Perception checks made to detect hidden objects and on saves made to avoid or resist traps
  •  War Caster: Concentration - Advantage on Concentration saves for spells

Spells

  •  Beacon of Hope - Targets have advantage on Wisdom and death saves

Items

  • Absolute's Talisman - Advantage on death saves if the wearer has the Brand of the Absolute
  • Essence of Ether - Suffer the effects of sophorific drug and automatically fail all Strength and Dexterity saves, upon consumption
  • Family Ring - Death saves +2
  • Gibus of the Worshipful Servant - Advantage on Concentration saves
  • Helldusk Boots - When the wearer fails a save, they can use their  Reaction to succeed it instead
  • Karabasan's Gift - Target suffers the effects of paralytic poison and automatically fails all Strength and Dexterity saves
  • Ring of Evasion - When the wearer fails a Dexterity save, they can use their  Reaction to succeed it instead
  • Tarnished Charm - Reduce the DC of wearer's death saves from 10 down to 5
  • Wizardsbane Oil - Target suffers disadvantage on Concentration saves

Conditions

  •  Blood-draw Sickness - Suffer a -1 penalty to all dice rolls until long rest (inflicted on a character who has had their blood drawn by Araj Oblodra)
  •  Mystra's Benevolence - Gale gains advantage on Concentration saves until long rest (see Balthazar's Experiment for details)
